title: The Faith of the Canaanite Woman
description: A Canaanite woman from Tyre and Sidon asks Jesus for help for her demon-possessed daughter. Despite being rejected, she persists, and Jesus commends her great faith and heals her daughter.

versions.title: The Faith of the Canaanite Woman
versions.description: A Canaanite woman asks Jesus for help for her daughter. Her great faith impresses Jesus.
